invariants.text: A sale can only be recorded if the product's current stock quantity is greater than or equal to the sale quantity.
Product.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Sale.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Sale.product_id must reference an existing Product.id
The quantity sold in a sale must be greater than zero.
The sale date must be a valid date in the past or present, not in the future.
The stock quantity of a product must not go below zero after a sale.
The sum of the quantities sold in all sales for a product must equal the difference between its initial stock quantity and its current stock quantity.
